reason: Zazzle's only API (https://www.zazzle.com/api, read earlier on 2026-09-25) is the Create-a-Product linkover URL for Ambassador referral links (associate id + template product id + image/text URL parameters that open a customised product page); a re-open in headless Chromium the same day hit Zazzle's bot page ('Oops! Are you Human or a Robot in Disguise?'). There is no authenticated store API to list, reprice, restock or end listings or to read and ship orders, so none of the channel verbs has a call.
